Sometimes the problem sits in one instrument, and a stereo file can't separate it. 🎛️

That is what Stem Pro is for: up to 6 grouped stems, for example drums, bass, guitars, vocals, keys and FX.

When it is worth it:
▸ The audit shows a clash between two elements, like kick and bass
▸ Vocals need to come forward without dragging the guitars along
▸ The mix is good, but one group is fighting the rest

€129 incl. VAT, full audit included, all platform exports, delivery in 48–72h, unlimited revisions.

Not sure if you need stems? Send the stereo bounce first and the audit will tell you.

The first thing you get back is not a master. It is a written report. 📝

It covers:
▸ Frequency balance against references for your subgenre
▸ Dynamics and loudness, including streaming compliance
▸ Stereo image, mono compatibility and phase below 80 Hz
▸ What is working, what isn't, and why
▸ The concrete mastering strategy that follows from it

So before a single processing step happens, you know what will change and for what reason. No black box.

Included in every package, from the €79 single upwards.

An EP is not five singles in a row. 🎚️

Mastered one by one, every track gets pushed to its own loudness and its own top end. Played in order, the record jumps.

The EP package treats it as one record:
▸ An audit for every track
▸ Loudness balanced across the whole EP
▸ Sequencing and the transitions between tracks worked out
▸ Unlimited revisions

Up to 5 tracks for €349, which is €46 less than five singles. Final price incl. 19% VAT, delivery in 5–7 days.

Ten tracks, one record. Does it sound like one? 💿

Album mastering at Polished is €629 for up to 10 tracks. As 10 singles you'd pay €790, so you keep €161 in the band fund.

I audit every track on its own, then I audit the whole album once more. That's how track one and track ten end up with the same loudness and the same tonal balance.

Pressing vinyl? Ask me for a vinyl-ready master. Revisions are unlimited, and you'll have the album back in 7 to 14 days.

All prices incl. 19% VAT.
